# Field boundaries for Latvia - Eurocrops 2021

Latvia - Eurocrops 2021 field boundaries (2021) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Lauku atbalsta dienests <https://www.lad.gov.lv/lv/lauku-registra-dati>, EuroCrops. License: CC-BY-SA-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lv/latest/ec_lv.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lv/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:3059; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: EC_NUTS3, parcel_id, crop:code, hcat:name_en, geometry, id, metrics:area, subsidy_type, hcat:name, determination:datetime, hcat:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lv/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lv/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_lv/collection.json
